A little about me

Strategy first. Consistency always.

I'm Victory Obongha, a social media strategist and content manager. I plan the content, write the captions, manage the community, and keep the whole account moving, so the people I work with can stay focused on their actual work.

I've worked across a few different worlds: a nutritionist specialising in seizure and epilepsy care, a fashion brand, and independent practitioners building a client base from scratch. Different industries, same process, understand who the ideal client actually is, then build content that speaks straight to them.

I completed the Marketing Masterclass with Team Paragon, sharpening how I think about strategy and positioning, on top of the hands-on experience of actually running accounts week to week.

Based in Nigeria. Working with clients wherever they are.

What I do

Full content and social strategy, handled

From the first-line strategy to the last posted caption, here's what taking this off your plate actually looks like.

01

Content Strategy & Calendars

A clear plan for what gets posted, when, and why, built around who your ideal client actually is, not a generic template with your name swapped in.

02

Content Creation & Captions

Captions, carousels and post copy written in your voice, so nothing sounds borrowed, generic, or like it could belong to anyone else.

03

Social Media Management

Day-to-day handling of your accounts: posting, scheduling, and keeping the page consistent even when you don't have the time to think about it.

04

Community Management

Replying, engaging, and building the kind of relationship with your audience that turns a follower into a DM, and a DM into an inquiry.

05

Brand Voice & Positioning

Figuring out exactly what makes you different, then making sure every single post sounds like it could only have come from you.

06

Growth Tracking & Optimisation

Watching what's actually working each month and adjusting the plan around it, not just posting on a schedule and hoping.
